text:
Hospitals and prisons
are the worst
asylums
are the worst
attics
are the worst
noisy little hotels
are the worst
poetry readings
rock concerts
for the benefit of the disabled
are the worst
funerals
weddings
are the worst
parades
skating rinks
sexual orgies
are the worst
midnight
3 in the morning
5:45 in the afternoon
are the worst.

Falling from the sky
firing squads
that is the best
thinking of India
watching popcorn stands
seeing the bull take the matador
that is the best
light bulbs in boxes
an old dog digging
peanuts in a paper bag
that is the best
spraying cockroaches
a pair of clean socks
natural courage defeating natural talent
that is the best
standing before firing squads
throwing crumbs to gulls
slicing tomatoes
that is the best
carpets burned with cigarettes
cracks in sidewalks
waitresses still sane
that is the best
my dead hands
my dead heart
silence
adagio of rocks
the world in flames
that is the best
for me.

translation.title: The Best and the Worst
translation.editorial_note:
Translated from the supplied Spanish version attributed to Charles Bukowski. The deliberately repetitive catalog and lineation are preserved.

Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
